seo.title: About Us
seo.description: Sloane Street Auctions: an independent auction house on Fulham Road, Chelsea, offering fine art, antiques and collectables.

hero.title: About Sloane Street Auctions
hero.text:
Sloane Street Auctions' primary objective is to work with both our buyers and sellers to provide the art market access to the rarest objects and art - from Classical Antiquities, Icons and Old Masters, right through to the YBAs and beyond.

Sloane Street Auctions takes great pleasure in dealing with people. We aim to provide a seamless and pleasant service, whether buying or selling. Our vision is to unearth the world's greatest treasures and to match them with the world's greatest collectors, whether an occasional buyer or a seasoned connoisseur. Sloane Street Auctions prides itself in providing the highest level of client service and discretion.

statements.title: Our approach
statements.body: Free valuations, clear terms and a personal service at every stage, from first enquiry to the sale itself.

statements.title: Our expertise
statements.body: Paintings, works on paper, furniture, sculpture, decorative arts and jewellery, catalogued and photographed by our specialists.

statements.title: Our clients
statements.body: Private owners, collectors and estates, with buyers bidding in our Chelsea saleroom, online and by telephone.
